statutory_framework.standard_code: AIS-063 (Automotive Industry Standard: Code of Practice for Construction of School Buses)
statutory_framework.supreme_court_ruling: M.S. Grewal & Ors. v. Deep Chand Sood & Ors., (2001) 8 SCC 151

checklist_items.title: Golden Yellow Livery & 'School Bus' Signage
checklist_items.description: Bus painted in golden yellow with prominent 'SCHOOL BUS' in bold black letters on front and rear.

checklist_items.title: Speed Limiting Governor Capped at 40 km/h
checklist_items.description: Mandatory speed governor or ECU speed limiter limiting maximum speed to 40 km/h.

checklist_items.title: Horizontal Window Safety Grills
checklist_items.description: Windows fitted with horizontal safety grills/mesh to prevent children protruding limbs.

checklist_items.title: Serviceable ISI Certified Fire Extinguisher
checklist_items.description: At least one ABC powder fire extinguisher of 2kg capacity mounted near driver.

checklist_items.title: Fully Stocked First Aid Kit
checklist_items.description: Kit containing unexpired antiseptic, sterile gauze, bandages, and burn ointment.

checklist_items.title: Emergency Exit Door with Audible Cabin Alarm
checklist_items.description: Functional rear or side emergency door with clearly marked opening mechanism and driver alarm.

checklist_items.title: Functional GPS Tracking & Interior CCTV
checklist_items.description: MoRTH AIS-140 compliant vehicle tracking unit and internal surveillance cameras.

checklist_items.title: Reliable Mechanical Door Safety Locks
checklist_items.description: Doors fitted with safe locks and handles operable only by the attendant or driver.

checklist_items.title: Trained Conductor / Female Attendant On Board
checklist_items.description: Qualified attendant present in bus to assist children during boarding and deboarding.

checklist_items.title: Driver with Min 5 Years Clean Commercial Record
checklist_items.description: Driver must possess valid transport licence for min 5 years without major violation record.
